note: ds-proposals/ and transitions/ are reference material and the app doesn't import either. The 7 literal colours left are counted on purpose rather than ignored: src/Starfield.jsx draws on a canvas, which only takes colour strings, so it reads --star-cold, --star-warm and --ds-color-bg at mount and fills in rgba() templates (6), and the theme-color meta in index.html can't read a custom property, so it copies --ds-color-bg by hand (1). Kept on purpose and not flagged by the audit: the starfield, the constellation clock and the hero lines coming in one after another are the site's look, so they stay even though motion elsewhere was cut.
